issues.title: This autocomplete attribute value has an unknown term that is not a correct autocomplete field.
issues.why_it_matters_for_persona: As an autistic person, I rely on consistent and predictable web experiences to manage cognitive load and reduce anxiety. When input fields are not correctly identified for autofill, I have to manually enter information like my username every time. This breaks my workflow and increases the chance of making a mistake, which can be frustrating and stressful.
remediation_instructions: Replace the invalid autocomplete value 'badname' with a valid token from the WCAG list of autocomplete values.
For a username field, the correct attribute would be `autocomplete="username"`.
expected_tool_change: An automated accessibility tool should flag the use of an invalid or unknown value in the `autocomplete` attribute.
A code linter might also report an error for using a non-standard value.
